calls.title: FF in Experiments Eng Kickoff
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the integration of feature flag values and experiment variations, emphasizing safer draft handling and approval processes. Changes to feature values must be approved before experiments start, ensuring consistency and accuracy. The team discussed the complexities of merging approval flows for features and experiments, aiming to prevent conflicts. They also highlighted the need for clear UI indications for draft states and automated cleanup processes for discarded links. Mid-experiment changes are discouraged; focus will remain on safe editing within approved drafts. API design considerations were discussed to balance complexity and functionality, with assignments for further investigation into engineering and UI patterns.
calls.keywords: Feature flags, experiment approval flows, draft revisions, variation management, API endpoints, UI workflow
calls.action_items:

Begin engineering investigation into managing draft revisions and feature value changes from the experiment page (56:59)

**Luke Sonnet**
Follow up with designer Kari regarding UI pattern and table design for experiment-feature editing workflow to determine next design steps (42:38)
Document discussion about deferring live changes in experiments to future versions and overlay existing approval flow limitations (56:18)
Consider architectural approach to handle experiment and feature flag data merging or separation and how it affects API endpoints (47:10)

**Adriel Vieira**
Partner with Michael to review and split engineering tasks related to draft revisions and experiment feature value management (56:59)
